items.title: Giacomo Gates interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, November 11, 2017 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: I can remember going to listen to I think it was Joe Lovano and Bob Dorough together at Birdland

ctx.x: That got the laugh, yeah. Well I think, I don’t know again, you know I’m just winging it. People come to a musical presentation. I don’t know if they realize that as far as I’m concerned they’re allowed to laugh and have a good time. It’s not okay, we have to listen to this now. No. Have a good time. It’s supposed to be fun. I can remember going to listen to I think it was Joe Lovano and Bob Dorough together at Birdland, maybe fifteen years ago, maybe more. And they were funny. And I was laughing. And nobody else…
Because his music’s got a sense of humor in it. So sometimes you have to let them know, it’s okay to laugh, folks. You can have a good time while you’re here.
